lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: ...must do so.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Sorry?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'll say it again. You must meet the Champions and receive their power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said Iris needs to complete her own power... Why does she need the Champions' power?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Iris may have become a god, but her current power falls far short of those we call Champions.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: She needs to reach a level of power equal to theirs, or greater. With her current abilities, that seems impossible.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what should we do?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Iris will face and cut down her fear and dread in the Training Forest...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: While you must meet the Champions in person and bring back a portion of their power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How am I supposed to bring back power? That's awfully vague.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You needn't worry too much about that. There must be a way to receive it from them, in one form or another.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: We're running out of time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's this important, shouldn't Iris go herself?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: She could. But what do you think would happen if Iris were exposed to the outside world in her current unstable condition?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: There are many who covet her divine authority. No one knows what catastrophe might follow if she acts rashly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: And there is another problem. 'That world' is coming back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait... By 'that world,' you mean...?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: According to the Jewel School mages, 'that world' has changed course and is heading back here.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Just because the demigod Belosh had his divine power sealed in his battle with Weiss, a world sent so far away is coming back...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: The whole thing was absurd from the start. A world created by the power of a god, however great that god may be! How could a mere demigod possibly have dealt with it?!

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'm sorry. I lost my composure for a moment... That was rude of me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, it's all right. So how much time do we have left?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I don't know...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If Iris grows stronger than the Champions and becomes a true god...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Everything will be resolved. The demons seeking divine power, the Agasuras who cannot help committing evil, even the Deimos cult...

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Please. Seek the great spirits at once, and learn what to do from their wisdom. They should be more helpful than I am.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I suppose I'd better. Sigh... All right, I'm off.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Would Harmonia know?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The path to the inner world is still open. I'd better hurry.)
(Yuran senses someone behind her and turns around. A middle-aged man with a kindly, upright bearing is watching her.)
(Everyone in the Alliance Headquarters respectfully greets the middle-aged man, addressing him as Ziskad or Alliance Leader.)

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: You look exhausted.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'm all right, Master.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: Thank you for handling matters so well while I was away.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Not at all. I was only doing what I had to do.

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: The one who just passed by was that person, then.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Yes. The errand-runner for Iris I told you about...

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: What do you think of that person?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It's a long story. Do you have the time?

lines.speaker: 지스카드
lines.text: I do. Let us go somewhere else, and I'll hear it.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Welcome, adventurer. We meet again so soon.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I think I know why you've come. Shall I guess?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? How do you know? I haven't said anything yet.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Though I'm inside the goddess's inner world, I naturally become aware of conversations concerning her when they take place nearby.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Since the goddess is in Lumen, I can learn something of what's happening there, even if not every detail.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'd better not say anything bad about you, Harmonia. If you hear all of it...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Oh... Have I done something wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hehe, I'm joking.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: The goddess's current power is sorely lacking.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: To strengthen her unstable abilities, she needs help from those who wield their power with stability.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Champions...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Humans with abilities close to those of gods. If they acknowledge you, you may be able to bring back traces of their power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If those traces are objects, I can bring them to Iris. But what if they aren't?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: You simply need to receive their power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Just receive it? Don't tell me the power goes whoosh and gets transmitted to her?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Something like that. Just as the goddess showed you the path of dreams... part of your minds is already connected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She's not seeing too much, is she? That sounds like an invasion of privacy...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: ...Don't take it too seriously. It's easier to think of it as a spiritual connection.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief. Then I need to meet an Champion... Who should I visit first, and where?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Try speaking to Mir. That child knows more about the outside world than I do.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Oh, right. Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: It's nothing urgent, but once this is over and you have some time, I hope you'll come hear my story.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: There's no hurry. If you remember, please come back and speak to me later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will, Harmonia. I'll be going, then. Take care.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Oh! Adventurer!

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Did you still have something to do here? Or have you brought me some jerky?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Actually, about that jerky... Never mind. I'll buy you lots of it later, so could you tell me where to find the Champion closest to Lumen?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Oh! Really? Really really? You aren't lying?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really. I promise. In the name of the mighty jerky—no, in the goddess's name! I, %s, promise Mir some jerky.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Wow, I'm so touched! To think you'd promise me jerky... I'll tell you everything you need to know. But why are you looking for an Champion?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain to Mir why you need to find the Champions.)

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I see. If it's for the goddess, I'm happy to help. Lord Ziskad came back a moment ago, but he's already left again.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Then you'll want an Champion closer than Atkina in the Land of Illusions, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know where the Land of Illusions is, but where can I find someone closer?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: If you keep going west from the Kingdom of Jude, you'll reach the Amaloon Desert. There's a city underground nearby, called Tartaros. Its ruler is an Champion.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I have to go all the way through the desert... What kind of person are they?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Let me tell you about Shynic, the King of the Underworld.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: King of the Underworld? As in, king of death?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: That's right. Long ago, when the continent was in turmoil, she sent an enormous number of people to their deaths on the battlefield.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I don't know whether it's punishment for her sins or a curse, but now she has a body that won't stay dead, even if she dies.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She's not undead, is she...?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: She's human, not undead. She only looks like a young girl. She's a much more complicated person than you might think.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: And don't upset her. One wrong move, and she might kill you on the spot...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be careful. Thank you. You know Yuran at the Lumen Alliance Headquarters, right? I'll tell her about the jerky, so go ask her for some whenever you need it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll settle the bill afterward.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Really? Wow, you're an amazing adventurer! I really like you! I'll be cheering you on, so have a good trip! I'm off to get some jerky!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, gone already...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it makes Mir that happy, I don't need to mention that the jerky is pet food, do I? Well, off to Tartaros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello. Um...

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: It feels like you only just left.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm bored... If I die of this, will Melvic put 'Here lies Shynic, who died of boredom' on my gravestone?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Aaah, I'm bored.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello. Um...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Found someone who looks fun! ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Excuse me. What do you mean, I look fun?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Exactly what I said. You look fun. Ahaha! ♡

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So what is it? Not many people speak to me directly. You must want something from me. Right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have a favor to ask...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: A favor... I don't know what it is, but if it's fun, I'll do it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not really fun...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly explain your request to Shynic.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hmm... So there's nothing in it for me? I don't feel like doing anything right now. Go away.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What do you think would happen if you kept pestering me? You've heard about me, so I assume you're prepared for the consequences.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Urgh...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Why don't you forget the goddess's errands and take a nice break here in Tartaros?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I built this place however I pleased. As long as you don't upset me, you're free to use whatever you like.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: My butler Melvic will arrange a place for you to stay. So go enjoy a look around the city.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don't have a choice. I'll have to wait a little...)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What are you doing? Aren't you leaving? If you don't, I'll take your head right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A-all right. I'm going. I'll go, okay?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Hehe...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What is it with that one, though...? That expression is strange. People who've lost a little of their memory used to look like that...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, whatever. Too much trouble. It's not even entertaining, so why does it keep bothering me?

steps.name: Troublemakers at the Construction Site
steps.objective: Defeat [Mischievous Shynic Phantoms] and [Gravekeeper Shaz] at the "Underground City Construction Site", then report to [Melvic].

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Hello, adventurer. Welcome to Tartaros.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: An apparition of Lady Shynic arrived in such a hurry, I wondered what had happened.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I'd been wondering when you might visit Tartaros, and now here you are. It's an honor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know about me?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I've heard that you fight for righteous causes with your characteristic bravery.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: They say you fight like an executioner, and since you work for the goddess, people here in Tartaros call you the 'Goddess's Executioner.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An executioner? And not just any executioner—the goddess's?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh... I suppose it's not entirely wrong. Thank you for looking after me.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Hehe, not at all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Judging by your expression, there's something you'd like to say.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: You read me like a book! Indeed, I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I don't know what Lady Shynic is thinking, but lately she hasn't done a thing. Normally, when something catches her interest, she pursues it without a moment's rest...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I've been handling some of the city's affairs, but taking on all her duties, including security and administration, was too much. So I hired outside help.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: But that has caused a small problem. Before I continue, could I ask you one favor?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: If it wouldn't be too much trouble, could you drive away the creatures disrupting the construction site?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I'm sorry I can't explain everything right now. It's rather urgent. I'll tell you the rest when you return.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: You seem hesitant. While you're away, I'll speak to Lady Shynic on your behalf, so that you can obtain what you came for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh! Yes! I'll be back as quickly as I can!

steps.name: Chaos at the Construction Site
steps.objective: Defeat [Priring-Masked Thieves] and [Gargoyle Statues] at the "Underground City Construction Site", then report to [Melvic].

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Excellent work! You've taken quite a weight off my mind.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I did speak to Lady Shynic, but she still seems to be in a foul mood.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. I suppose I'll have to wait a little longer...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Then let me continue my explanation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, please do.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: We hired the Blue Spear Guild, which is well known for its security work. The problem is that they haven't been doing their job properly.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Monsters have escaped from the Abyss Chamber. Bandits heard that the city had been left unattended and came here. And...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Members of the Blue Spear Guild seem to have plans of their own. With all of them mixed together, the construction site has become utter chaos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we'd better deal with that chaos first. Shall I get going?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Pardon? I haven't even asked you yet...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be right back. You've helped me too, so I'll take care of it quickly.

steps.name: Why the City Is in Chaos
steps.objective: Find [Ruin] at the "Underground City Construction Site".

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Thank you, adventurer. You've dealt with one of Tartaros's greatest concerns...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing. By the way, how is Lady Shynic?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: She still hasn't given me an answer. What should we do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You've done your best, Melvic. It can't be helped. I'll stay a few days, then move on somewhere else.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Are you sure? There may be something of interest to you at the Hall of Heroes...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Hall of Heroes?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: We built the Hall of Heroes because Lady Shynic wanted a landmark for our city.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: It contains treasured possessions of the seven living Champions, books recounting the lives of past Champions, and so on.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: It's a small museum. There aren't many exhibits, but we do have a decent collection.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you get such valuable things? Surely some of the Champions are hostile?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: For the most part, she stole them.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: If someone refused to hand something over, she would pick a fight and make use of her curse.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't tell me she kept coming back from the dead and doing it again until they got sick of her?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Yes, precisely. Ahahaha. That is exactly the sort of thing Lady Shynic would do.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: At present, I can't enter the Hall of Heroes. Randaine, master of the Blue Spear Guild, went inside and hasn't come out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... The guild master who's plotting something...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Judging by your expression, you're thinking of visiting the memorial hall. In that case, let me ask for your help one more time.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Ruin, a senior member of the Blue Spear Guild, is at one side of the construction site. Ask him about the memorial hall and his guild master.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: He should be able to tell you something useful.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Oh, %s. There's something else I'd like to ask of you, if you don't mind.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: If you're interested, please come and speak to me later.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: For now, you should look into the Hall of Heroes. That matter is urgent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'd better. I'll get going right away.

steps.name: One with Twisted Power
steps.objective: Go to the "Hall of Heroes" and defeat [Randine], then report to [Ruin].

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: So it's you. I saw you dealing with those nuisances over there and asked around. You're the hero who saved the Kingdom of Jude?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not really a hero... but if that's what people say, I suppose so.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: You're not denying it, then. Since you've come here, I assume there's something you want from me...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could you tell me what's happening in the Hall of Heroes?

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: I wasn't planning to tell you that much...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Melvic said you would tell me.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: If Melvic sent you, I suppose I have no choice. This has gone beyond anything I can handle.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Our guild master Randaine has gone mad. All he wanted was to make the guild stronger. I never imagined it would come to this...

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: He seems to have gained some kind of power... but it isn't ordinary power. It's something no human should ever touch.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: He would use it, then suffer for it. Something was terribly wrong. Many of our members tried to stop him, but... it was hopeless.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: It happened inside the Hall of Heroes in Tartaros, but Shynic didn't care at all. As though she were waiting for someone else to deal with it.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: The guild members who feared Randaine's power swore loyalty to him. Those who didn't were killed by him, crazed as he was with that power.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Then he went into the memorial hall. He plans to use it as a base and seize Tartaros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That kind of tremendous power does remind me of something...

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Randaine struggled and agonized over what was happening. But now he's a monster who doesn't even question it.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Please. A hero like you coming here can't be a coincidence. I think you can save Randaine, and Tartaros too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You keep calling me a hero. It's a little embarrassing. Still, shall I take a look? I can visit the memorial hall while I'm at it...

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: You seem to be taking this lightly. Even so, you'd better be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for your concern. I'll be right back.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Oh, there's something I wanted to ask. Hey! Hey! Gone already.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: (Ruin senses someone watching him from the shadows.)

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: You there. The one eavesdropping. Who are you?

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: (Ruin approaches the place where he sensed someone, but no one is there.)

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Huh? Did I imagine it? I'm sure someone was here... Wasn't there? I've had a lot on my mind because of Randaine. Maybe that's all it was. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: What's this, though...? Looks like someone dropped something...

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: You're back. Then Randaine must have been dealt with... That fool, Randaine...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: By the way, do you know anything about these?

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: (Ruin takes some small stones from his pocket and shows them to you.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh! These are...! Where did you find them?

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: I sensed someone over there earlier and went to look. They were inside a pouch someone had dropped.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: What are they, anyway? Why are you so shocked?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They're magic stones.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Magic stones? Stones with magical power in them?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right, but these seem different from the ones Ban and Mara made. Magic stones with no magic left in them...

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: I don't know who Ban and Mara are, but they sound like bad news, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. They're truly awful people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: These couldn't have ended up here by coincidence. What if...

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: I'll take care of the cleanup here. I don't know much about this, but...

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Those magic stones... I found them near the Abyss Chamber.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Abyss Chamber? Then I'd better go there.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: You need Shynic's permission to enter the Abyss Chamber. It isn't a place just anyone can visit...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you need permission just to enter, it must be incredibly dangerous.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: You guessed right. Shynic can't stand being bored, so she filled it with monsters to make it an entertaining place.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Then demons found their way into the chamber from somewhere. Shynic thought that was amusing and raised a magical barrier so that even they couldn't escape.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: After that, she put piles of gold and treasure inside and spread the word: anyone who killed the demons in the chamber could keep whatever treasure they dropped.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: And so people flocked there to face that bizarre, revolting, hideous darkness and its demons...

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Many died, but Shynic paid little attention. Stranger still, everyone just shrugged it off, saying she'd always been like that...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That sounds terrible. How could anyone...

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: But then Malphas, the strongest of the demons, apparently revived the ghost of a human mage. After that, Shynic began acting strangely.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: She turned away all the adventurers heading for the Abyss Chamber and forbade anyone from entering.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Many adventurers hoping to claim the gold and treasure asked why, but she wouldn't answer.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: I have no idea what she's thinking. That's why Randaine tried to take over this place with that strange power of his...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've been to all sorts of places, but I don't think I've ever seen a city with such complicated problems.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And its ruler, Lady Shynic, has quite an unusual personality...

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: I think you should tell Shynic what happened and get her permission before you go inside.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: As for me, I'll have to think about what to do with the remaining guild members. That seems to be my responsibility now. Anyway, thanks for helping.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing. I'll be going now.

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Yeah, all right. Gone already. Is that impatience, or decisiveness?

lines.speaker: 루인
lines.text: Still, that one... seems to understand how to use great power properly. Impressive... Unlike that fool Randaine...

steps.name: The Abyss at the End of Tartaros
steps.objective: Defeat [Ixion] and [Malphas] in the "Abyss Chamber", then report to [Shynic] in the "Underground City Tartaros".

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You look as though you've been waiting for me.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Thinking of going to the Abyss Chamber? I don't mind if you do, but... must you really go?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you're hiding something, would you tell me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's nothing here you couldn't do. If you're doing nothing, you must have a reason. There could be serious danger ahead. Is it really all right to just sit here?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What danger could there be with me around?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could you take a look at this? Randaine had it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You show Shynic the magic stone with no magic left in it.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, an unusual magic stone. Let me see... It's from the Deimos cult. Huh? But it was made using an Agasura spell formula...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could Ban and Mara have joined forces with the Deimos cult...?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You mean that clan of fake Agasuras. Those fakes can't even tell the genuine article from a counterfeit. Don't worry about them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean, genuine and fake Agasuras?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Explaining that sounds like a bother...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh... You know the Agasuras are beings who have no choice but to commit evil, right? What if they're targeting Tartaros?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Their ultimate target might be the goddess. That's why I have to enter the Abyss Chamber.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Doing nothing won't make this go away, Lady Shynic. Someone has to act.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If you're that determined, I won't stop you. I wonder if you'll make it back alive.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everyone says that, but I've always come back alive.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So confident. You're really entertaining...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: At last, you're no longer bored. Well, I simply believe in myself, and in the people who believe in me.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Is that so? Then go deal with Malphas, the demon trying to make the Abyss Chamber his base.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: He entered the chamber through a dimensional rift, so I caught him and locked him in. But he kept growing stronger by absorbing adventurers' souls.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: He swore he'd get revenge on me. I wonder how strong he's become.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that everything? I don't think it is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then tell me later. I'll take that as permission and be on my way.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (Shynic stares intently at %s's back as they head for the Abyss Chamber.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Oh, Melvic...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Our guest has left, then. Um, Lady Shynic...?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Shouldn't we stop them? The Abyss Chamber is currently...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: ...It'll work out somehow, won't it?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Sigh. I can do anything else, but I can't face him again. Perhaps I could if I were a god. That's why everyone wants to become one.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: No matter how much power you have, a human who's nothing but an empty shell can only get so far. Look at me. Look how helpless I am.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Lady Shynic...

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: A human—and only one—has made it this far... Even trapped here in the Abyss Chamber, I've never had anyone reach me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew. It was pretty tough.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: You seem to be on a different level from other humans. The very composition of your power is unlike theirs.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: I had no idea that old fool was too weak to stop a single human. What a waste of effort waking him was.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: I thought he'd be able to deal with Shynic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Old fool? The mage who appeared as a ghost? What's he got to do with Shynic?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: You want to know? Then you'll have to defeat me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So if I defeat you, you'll answer my questions properly?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: If you can win. I promise. Unlike Lux and the other demons, I keep my word.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: But before we settle that promise, I have a proposal. Why not put your power to work for me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why would I?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: You look doomed to spend your life running errands for someone else... If that's all you have to look forward to, why not serve me?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: I, the great Malphas, will give you the souls of the humans who enter the Abyss Chamber.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: The more souls you devour, the stronger you'll become, until you can laugh at Lux. I've already made the chamber work that way. What do you say?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: I'm offering you the honor of becoming a great human. Think carefully.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Heh. What a stupid crow. Do you really think I'd take a demon's words at face value?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Foolish human. You'll regret this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I refuse. Humans, demons—everyone keeps doing stupid things out of an obsession with power. Of course power is useful, but this isn't the way!

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Power is good. Why would you think otherwise? What about the power you possess right now?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Be honest with yourself. Once you have power, you seek greater heights and rule over those beneath you.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Now, I'll ask you one more time. Will you serve me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And I'll say it again: I refuse! I'll defeat you and find out what I want to know!

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: What a spirited rejection of my offer. Heh.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Very well. If you defeat me, I'll answer your questions. But you'll never live to hear my tale.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: I will devour your soul right here. That is your fate. That is the truth of this world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Then shall we put that to the test?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Come at me, foolish human! You cannot even accept why power exists!

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Impossible... To think I would fall like this. The price of underestimating a human...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Mr. Demon? Stay with me. I have questions. Are you going to answer them? Mr. Demon? Hello?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: ...Very well.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: I have lost. I'll answer your questions properly. A promise is a promise.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm surprised you'd admit defeat... It's rare to see that from someone who calls himself evil. Interesting. Take a look at this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know anything about this magic stone? It was found at the entrance to the Abyss Chamber.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You show Malphas the magic stone.)

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: A Deimos cult magic stone bearing an Agasura spell formula... An interesting object. You say it was lying outside the Abyss Chamber?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Shynic's binding curse prevents me from taking even one step outside the chamber. How interesting that this was found right out front.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Those Agasuras must be plotting something. They aren't even demons, yet they're always hard at work doing evil. Beyond that, I know nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Then who was the mage who appeared as a ghost?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: You don't know Ixion, the heroic mage who defended the Kingdom of Jude during Eastland's Dark War long ago?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not from around here. How would I know? Though the name does sound familiar... Oh, I heard it in Lumen.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Ixion was a human who would do anything to protect his kingdom from the Deimos cult. Even to a demon like me, he was mad. Heh heh...

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: He thought it would bring him glory. In the end, he chose to do something worthy of the Deimos cult itself.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: He forcibly infused young children with magic and used dark 'bindings' to send them onto the battlefield. Weapons, nothing more...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Bindings?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: You might call it an inescapable curse... Even the Deimos cult took an interest in it.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Many people died, and their souls fell into the hands of demons. I gathered plenty of souls myself. For that, I am grateful to Ixion.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And they honor a mage like that as a hero? Does the Kingdom of Jude know what he did?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: They probably don't know that much. Humans are foolish. Even if they knew, they'd cover it up. You have a demon's word on that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shut up. What happened to the children?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Curious, are you? Then I'll tell you. The magic Ixion forced into them drove them berserk and eventually killed them.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: When the war ended, Ixion killed the children who hadn't already died from it. They were no longer useful. That was their fate...

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: But one child survived. A child who cherished a red ribbon above all else...

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: There was no grand reason for her survival. Good luck or bad, a curse simply made her unable to die. That child was...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shh. That's enough. I don't need to hear any more.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: Is that so? Then shall we bring this conversation to an end?

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: It was a pleasure, human who defeated me... Farewell.

lines.speaker: 말파스
lines.text: (With a mocking smile, Malphas chooses to destroy himself.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey! Wait!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Malphas vanishes without a trace. Not a hint of evil remains; he seems to have been truly destroyed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it over now...? Ah, I shouldn't say that. Things usually come back when someone says that...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whew. Time to go. I have plenty of questions for Shynic.

steps.name: Finished for Now
steps.objective: Talk to [Melvic] in the "Underground City Tartaros".

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You're back. Malphas may be a foolish demon, but he couldn't have been easy to defeat...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was difficult.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: So, did you find out what you wanted?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. All the demon knew was that the stone belonged to the Deimos cult and was made with an Agasura spell formula. I learned nothing else.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing at all.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Nothing at all.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Ahahahaha! You're such an entertaining human. And an entertaining-looking one, too. ♡ Isn't that right, Goddess's Executioner?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not an executioner. (Dead serious.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Executioner, errand-runner—what does it matter? All I need to do is reward you with what you wanted, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glad we're on the same page.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Then come a little closer. Let's see. What a lovely head. May I put my hand on it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I say no, you'll do something terrifying, won't you?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Bingo! Exactly. How did you know? Hehe. ♡

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (Shynic rests her hand on %s's head. Black and red light swirls around her fingertips, then gathers into a single whirling glow.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (The light envelops %s's head and disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? That's it?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Anticlimactic, isn't it? You'd expect passing on power to be complicated, but it's surprisingly dull. It was like that back then, too... Ah, pretend you didn't hear that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (By 'back then,' she probably means...)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That should help the novice goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't really feel a dramatic difference.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'm not sure either. No one knows what that power will become later. Right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll be going.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You're just going to use me and leave? How could you? I'm hurt. ♡

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, Lady Shynic... You do realize how easily someone could get the wrong idea from what you just said?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's because I want to use you for something entertaining.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Entertaining? It won't be dangerous, will it?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's a secret for now. Wait a little while, all right? There's someone I want you to meet.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: And in the meantime, be careful not to get yourself killed by the snake biting its own tail. ♡ That snake likes swallowing people like you.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Now go see Melvic. Don't come back until I call for you. If I change my mind, who knows what I'll do? Hehe. Get a few days of good rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. See you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh. I'd better go. But what's this snake biting its tail supposed to mean?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Shynic watches %s intently until they disappear from view.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (A dark, seemingly male silhouette appears in the shadowy alley behind Shynic.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (With a faint mocking smile, Shynic walks into the alley.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: What a foul stench of beast.
Thank you for your cooperation.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I should be thanking you. Though all that happened was that our little friend followed the course you'd planned.
As promised, when all of this is over, I will grant your wish. There isn't much time left, so please wait a little longer. I ask this of you.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Sounds like you've got plenty to take care of. I wonder if you can really do it. Can a dying man accomplish what even a god couldn't...?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Now that I think of it, I'm jealous. Of the fact that you're dying...
What an odd thing to envy.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Enough of that. I'd rather you stayed out of my city for a while. If you appear here again, it will mean things haven't ended as they should.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Kazno Nas, leader of the Agasura clan.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (Shynic raises her Death Scythe and points it into the darkness.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: (The shadows gradually fade, revealing a young man with dreadlocks.)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: As willful as ever, King of the Underworld.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: If that time comes, I'll kill you myself. Well, at least I won't be bored.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: (Kazno gently pushes Shynic's Death Scythe aside with a finger.)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: I won't die at your hands. I still have much to do for this world, and for an old friend.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: A rather troublesome business, that...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: It seems you've finished speaking with Lady Shynic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She told me to take a few days off and rest.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Understood. You really are remarkable, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Changing Lady Shynic's mind is no easy feat...

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: And thank you for keeping it a secret.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh! You knew...?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: No. I merely thought there must be something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What's with this man, too...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Destroying Malphas was enough. Oh, by the way, who is the person Lady Shynic wants me to meet?

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: That, I don't know. I'm sure Lady Shynic will see to it. I am merely an ordinary butler, after all. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No matter how I look at it, he isn't ordinary at all.)

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Please rest well in the accommodation I've prepared until Lady Shynic calls for you again. If you need anything or find anything uncomfortable, let me know at once.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Since Lady Shynic has acknowledged you, I shall treat you as our most honored guest.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: Oh, %s. Another matter has come up that I'd like to ask you about. Would that be all right? It's a small thing, entirely optional.

lines.speaker: 멜빅
lines.text: I'll explain it to you in detail later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Thank you. I could use some rest now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Whew... I have no idea what might happen next. I wonder how Iris is doing.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm doing well. Please don't worry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris's faint image suddenly appears in %s's field of vision.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris? Is that really you? But you're in Lumen, aren't you?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, it's me. I've been continuing my training in the Training Forest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then how did you appear in front of me?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: How should I explain it...? It is my image, but it's something like a hologram that only %s can see.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: This is my first time trying it. What do you think?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What a handy feature!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You're talking as though I'm a magical communicator.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahahaha. I was so surprised, it just slipped out...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's all right. I did appear without warning. I simply thought about wanting to talk to you, and then we connected like this. It surprised me a little, too.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I think this happened because I received Lady Shynic's power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So a Champion's power really does help. That's a relief.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: But it hasn't stabilized yet, so I don't think I can keep this up for very lo—

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: (Iris's image freezes in place, then fades from view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's still a bit rough, but that's amazing. The power of just one Champion has already made this possible.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know if you can hear me... but hang in there, Iris. I'll keep doing my best, too.
